# HEPACART

> > HEPACART provides infection control, dust containment systems, and HEPA air filtration solutions for healthcare facilities, construction, and industrial applications.

HEPACART specializes in mobile dust containment carts, room isolation modules, and filtration systems designed to protect patients, workers, and sensitive environments from airborne particles and contamination. Based in Lenexa, Kansas, the company serves North America with both rental and purchase options for infection control equipment.

## Key Topics

- HEPA Filtration
- Dust Containment
- Infection Control
- Room Isolation
- Mobile Carts
- ICRA Standards
- AnteRoom
- STARC Systems
- Air Filtration
- Healthcare Facilities
- Construction Containment
- Airborne Particles
- MERV 16 Filters
- Temporary Isolation Modules

## Core Products

- [HEPACART Classic](https://www.hepacart.com/dust-containment/hepacart/hepacart-classic): HEPACART Classic mobile dust containment cart with HEPA filtration
- [HEPACART AutoLift](https://www.hepacart.com/dust-containment/hepacart/hepacart-autolift): HEPACART AutoLift with electric push-button control for dust containment
- [FloorZone Mobile Containment](https://www.hepacart.com/dust-containment/hepacart/floorzone): FloorZone mobile containment for flooring projects with HEPA filtration
- [DUSTBUGGY Classic](https://www.hepacart.com/dust-containment/dustbuggy-classic): DUSTBUGGY Classic portable dust containment cart for easy transport
- [AnteRoom](https://www.hepacart.com/dust-containment/anteroom): Award-winning AnteRoom temporary isolation module for room containment
- [Mintie ECU4 Dust Containment Tent](https://www.hepacart.com/dust-containment/ecu): Mintie ECU4 industry-leading dust containment tent with modular design
